user.title: Add a Skedda account
user.description: Sign in with the account you normally book with. The venue is the first part of its Skedda address: for https://myclub.skedda.com that is `myclub`.

data_description.alias: Shown in Home Assistant. Leave empty to use the venue name.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Skedda no longer accepts the stored password for {account}.

reconfigure.title: Edit the Skedda account
reconfigure.description: Change any of the account's details. The password is not shown and must be entered again.

data_description.alias: Shown in Home Assistant. Leave empty to use the venue name.

error.invalid_auth: Skedda rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the venue. Check the venue name and your connection.
error.unknown: The venue answered in a way this integration did not expect. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.account_mismatch: Those details belong to a different account. Add it as a new account instead of editing this one.
